Growers in the eastern United States report that it holds up extremely well in the combination of high heat and humidity. Fall color is a bright scarlet. The bark of the twigs and young branches is a deep maroon red, overcast with a whitish tone. This hardy plant is strongly cascading. It is an old cultivar, having been listed as early as 1710. sources.name: Tamukeyama Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Tamukeyama Japanese Maple is a stunning laceleaf variety that brings elegance and vibrant colour to any garden or landscape. Known for its deeply lobed, feathery leaves and graceful, weeping form, this tree is perfect for creating a focal point or adding texture to your outdoor space. The Tamukeyama’s cascading branches and rich red foliage make it particularly striking in the spring and summer, with vibrant hues of purple and red, and it transitions to stunning crimson and gold in the autumn. Reaching a height of around 3 to 4 meters, the Tamukeyama Japanese Maple, which is available for sale is ideal for small to medium-sized gardens, adding a dramatic touch without overwhelming the space. Its weeping form also makes it an excellent choice for containers, bringing beauty to patios, balconies, or smaller yards. The tree thrives in well-drained soil and partial shade, making it adaptable to a variety of garden environments. It is relatively low-maintenance once established and offers a long lifespan with minimal pruning required. rhs.description: A mound-forming, deciduous shrub or small tree with cascading shoots that bear finely-cut leaves which emerge purple to burgundy red in the spring. Leaves turn a greenish-purple in the summer before turning orange and brighter red in the autumn. Small purple-red flowers may be followed by winged fruits in the autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，株形呈 mound-forming，枝条下垂开展；叶片细裂，春季萌发时呈紫色至酒红色。夏季叶色转为带绿的紫色，秋季再转为橙色及更鲜亮的红色。小型紫红色花后，秋季可能结翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合护坡与斜坡地栽植，适合乡村/自然式花园，低养护，适合庭院/容器栽培、岩石园、城市/庭院花园
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种具有 Dissectum Group 那种多次深裂的叶片，但羽状深裂不像 ‘Crimson Queen’ 和 ‘Dissectum Nigrum’ 等品种那样深。每个裂片中央部分略宽，使叶形显得稍为厚实有力。7 或 9 个裂片向外放射展开，末端延伸成极细长的尖端，这是其他品种少见的特征。美国东部种植者反映，它在高温高湿并存的环境中表现尤其稳定。秋色为鲜亮猩红色。小枝和幼枝树皮呈深栗红色，其上覆有一层淡白色调。该品种耐寒，枝条强烈下垂。它是一个古老品种，早在 1710 年便已有记载。日本记录中有 50 至 100 年树龄、株高达 4 米的植株。Maplewood 收藏中一株名为 ‘Takiniyama’ 的植物，其叶形、叶色和生长习性与 ‘Tamuke yama’ 完全一致；随着植株成熟，其特征也表明它就是 ‘Tamuke yama’。目前未找到有关 ‘Takiniyama’ 的独立记录。‘Tamuke yama’ 还曾以 ‘Chirimen kaede’、‘Chirimen momiji’ 和 ‘Dissectum Tamuke yama’ 等名称流传。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Tamukeyama' Weeping Red Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Tamukeyama' Heat Tolerant Weeping Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Tamukeyama' is a weeping red laceleaf Japanese maple. This red weeping tree is very hardy and good vigorous grower too. 'Tamukeyama' leafs out in the early spring with deep shades of burgundy. This red weeping Japanese maple tree is one of the very best for holding its dark red coloration deep into the summer. The autumn color on Tamukeyama is a bright scarlet red. The characteristic of this Japanese maple is cascading with an umbrella-like shape. This weeping red laceleaf Japanese maple is a very old selection by Kobayashi Nursery of Japan. 'Tamukeyama' has been propagated for over 300 years and has stood the test of time. 'Tamukeyama' is a very cold hardy selection because it is late to leaf out, missing late freezes. This cultivar also grows great in high heat areas and is very sun tolerant. The color and hardiness make ‘Tamukeyama’ a perfect addition that brings timeless beauty to any location. 10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS
